description: This file implements functions for fetching JSON data from a browser control service, including handling authentication, rate limiting, error handling, and dispatching requests through a browser route dispatcher. It also defines a custom error class for application-level errors from the browser control service.

classes.name: BrowserServiceError
classes.description: Custom error class representing application-level errors from the browser control service.

methods.name: withLoopbackBrowserAuthImpl
methods.description: Adds authentication headers to a request based on config, auth tokens, or bridge registry, for loopback URLs.

methods.name: withLoopbackBrowserAuth
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls withLoopbackBrowserAuthImpl with dependencies.

methods.name: resolveBrowserRateLimitMessage
methods.description: Returns a rate limit message based on whether the URL is for browserbase.com or not.

methods.name: resolveBrowserFetchOperatorHint
methods.description: Provides user guidance for fetch operations depending on whether the URL is local or sandboxed.

methods.name: normalizeErrorMessage
methods.description: Normalizes error messages to trim whitespace or convert to string.

methods.name: appendBrowserToolModelHint
methods.description: Appends a hint message to the error message if not already included.

methods.name: discardResponseBody
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the response body stream to free resources.

methods.name: enhanceDispatcherPathError
methods.description: Enhances errors from dispatcher path with additional context and hints.

methods.name: enhanceBrowserFetchError
methods.description: Enhances fetch errors with user guidance and specific messages for timeouts or network issues.

methods.name: fetchHttpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP fetch with timeout, error handling, and rate limit detection, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: fetchBrowserJson
methods.description: Main exported function to fetch JSON data from a URL, handling local, sandbox, and dispatcher paths, with retries and error handling.
